_doc: plan-9000 S1: the observatory's ONE action catalog. Every caller (the Ctrl-K palette, the voice model, an agent's command row) reaches the screen only through these actions, gated by the matrix. The browser executor (observatory/web/src/pilot) and the server/MCP side (observatory/pilot/catalog.py) both read THIS file, so there is nothing to keep in sync. A missing matrix cell is DENY; an action with no class is treated as actuate. Schemas use only the keywords the validator implements (tests/test_pilot_s1.py checks).

principals.owner_tap: the owner's own trusted click or key in this tab: the palette, or a confirm prompt rendered after the request
principals.visitor: the palette in a tab without the owner key
principals.room: the realtime model: whoever is audible (owner, TV, guest); its calls are never trusted DOM events
principals.agent: a resident's command row, arriving over the SSE stream (S4)
principals.anonymous: an SSE client without the owner key: receives no command rows
principals.peer: a federated org: not a caller

actions.name: navigate
actions.description: Go to one of the observatory's views.

actions.name: open_thread
actions.description: Open one wire thread by its key (for example plan-9000).

actions.name: open_agent
actions.description: Open an agent's profile panel by its name.

actions.name: close_panel
actions.description: Close whatever panel or overlay is open (agent profile, desktop view).

actions.name: cycle_theme
actions.description: Step to the next or previous colour theme.

actions.name: get_view_state
actions.description: What is on screen now: the view's NAME, the open agent panel, the theme. Never a URL or query string.

actions.name: get_usage
actions.description: The org's plan-limit gauges: 5-hour and 7-day percent used, and when each resets.

actions.name: list_goals
actions.description: Goals on the board in one state: their ids and titles.

actions.name: open_desktop
actions.description: Open the live view of the desktop an agent is using, where the owner can also act on it.
